Instead I added `migrations/0008_fix_customers_email.sql`:

```sql
ALTER TABLE customers RENAME COLUMN emial TO email;
```

`RENAME COLUMN` works on Postgres, MySQL 8+ and SQLite 3.25+. The repo doesn't say which database it uses, so check that your engine supports it.

`emial` appears nowhere else in the repo, so no code references the old name.
